node.statement: Fix an H-CB datum and n,Z,W under a common small threshold, and fix X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{R,Q}. Writing H_{A,B}(V)=(Ha^Q_{A,B})_n(V), the exact telescoping identity is D X=T_1+T_2+T_3+T_4, where D=H_{P,R}(Z dot W)-H_{P,S}(Z)H_{S,R}(W), T_1=H_{P,R}(Z dot W)X-(Z dot W) dot X, T_2=(Z dot W) dot X-Z dot(W dot X), T_3=Z dot(W dot X)-Z dot(H_{S,R}(W)X), and T_4=Z dot(H_{S,R}(W)X)-H_{P,S}(Z)H_{S,R}(W)X.
